incrementalReviews.note: The four class-overhaul integration daggers and the soul_stone painting, generated under woc-item-icon-v1 and owner-reviewed pass on 2026-08-10; the 2026-08-09 campaign review of the prior 817 files stands unchanged.

The Veil-Wraith Courser mount reins icon: not a painted icon but a camera render of the shipped 3D model (scripts/render_mount_icons.mjs), same convention as the other reins_* icons; flattened onto an opaque background to meet the woc-item-icon-v1 opacity contract. Reviewed and passed 2026-08-13; the prior 822 files stand unchanged.

Grimtusk the Ironhide Boar mount reins icon: not a painted icon but a camera render of the shipped 3D model (scripts/render_mount_icons.mjs). Passes every MACHINE check (opaque, correctly dimensioned, in budget, unique hash) but does NOT satisfy the woc-item-icon-v1 STYLE contract (docs/design/item-icon-art-style.md forbids raw 3D thumbnails for item icons); this is a known, deliberately unresolved gap, corrected for reins_veil_wraith_courser in the entry below but intentionally left open here pending reference art (see the KNOWN GAP note on batchId grimtusk-boar-mount-2026-08-13 in public/ui/items/mapping.json). Added 2026-08-13; the prior 823 files stand unchanged.

Correction of the 2026-08-13 entry above: review found the Veil-Wraith Courser reins icon was a raw 3D camera render, which docs/design/item-icon-art-style.md (woc-item-icon-v1) explicitly forbids for item icons regardless of opacity, and that the earlier note's claim of matching an existing icon convention was inaccurate (every other reins_* icon is painted). Repainted as a three-quarter bust portrait (dark holy/shadow-duality coat, glowing blue eyes, curling antlers) superseding batchId veil-wraith-courser-mount-2026-08-13. reins_grimtusk_boar has the identical defect and is a deliberately scoped follow-up, not fixed in this pass (flagged in public/ui/items/mapping.json). Reviewed and passed 2026-08-13; the prior 824 files stand unchanged.

Windrend the Stormveil Shadewolf mount reins icon: not a painted icon but a camera render of the shipped 3D model (scripts/render_mount_icons.mjs), same convention as the other unresolved mount reins icons. Passes every MACHINE check (opaque, correctly dimensioned, in budget, unique hash) but does NOT satisfy the woc-item-icon-v1 STYLE contract (docs/design/item-icon-art-style.md forbids raw 3D thumbnails for item icons); a gpt-image-1 (gpt-image-2 successor) text-to-image attempt against the live OpenAI API this same session returned rate_limit_exceeded (Limit 0 on input-images for this org), confirming the same platform-side quota gap the boar/hound/panther icons hit remains unresolved. Known, deliberately unresolved gap tracked in public/ui/items/mapping.json. Added 2026-08-15; the prior 826 files stand unchanged.

reviewContract.highResolutionReview: Flagged and retried assets were additionally reviewed from their retained 512px masters.

visualVerdict.summary: All 827 shipping item-art files pass the MACHINE-CHECKABLE contract (dimensions, format, opacity, size, uniqueness; see machineChecks below): 817 reviewed in the 2026-08-09 campaign (documented retries included), plus the five class-overhaul integration additions owner-reviewed and passed on 2026-08-10, plus the Veil-Wraith Courser and Grimtusk the Ironhide Boar mount reins icons added on 2026-08-13, plus the Ashfang the Cinderhide Hound mount reins icon added on 2026-08-14, plus the Nightprowl the Duskveil Panther mount reins icon added on 2026-08-14, plus the Windrend the Stormveil Shadewolf mount reins icon added on 2026-08-15. Of those five, only the Veil-Wraith Courser icon fully satisfies the woc-item-icon-v1 STYLE contract (repainted 2026-08-13, see the correction entry below): reins_grimtusk_boar is a composed-but-still-photographic render (batchId grimtusk-boar-mount-composition-fix-2026-08-14), reins_cinderhide_hound is a raw 3D camera render (batchId cinderhide-hound-mount-2026-08-14), reins_nightprowl_panther is a raw 3D camera render (batchId nightprowl-panther-mount-2026-08-14), and reins_windrend_stormveil_shadewolf is a raw 3D camera render (batchId windrend-stormveil-shadewolf-mount-2026-08-15), all known, deliberately unresolved style-contract gaps tracked in public/ui/items/mapping.json, not passed style reviews. passIds below is a shipping-catalog membership list (every current owner id, all machine-check clean), not a claim that every id also clears the style contract.

nonVisualContentWatch.reason: The art correctly depicts the runtime chest slot, but the player-facing name is Skullsmasher's Warbelt.
nonVisualContentWatch.recommendation: Resolve the content name/slot decision separately; do not repaint the chest icon as a belt while the item remains slot=chest.
